dogecoin.text: #bitcoin is like Dwight Schrute the beet farmer.  He’s a serious character, void of fun, but a necessary part of the story.  @dogecoin is like Dwight’s brother Mose randomly running through the beet field.  He’s a little off, but is fun, and also a necessary part of the story.
@dogeofficialceo I panhandle now.  My cardboard sign says “accepting smiles, dogecoin, money to buy dogecoin, and Taco Bell”.
@MartinShkreli @ewarren Dogecoin was used to fund Carlos Escobar’s cocaine empire in the 80’s.  Crypto must be stopped.
